text:
emma: Quick kickoff for the "Postcard" micro-nurture tied to the benchmark webinar next week. Goal: convert registrants -> attendees and attendees -> trial actions. Need final segments, a compressed 5-email cadence, and two creative tests (Postcard vs Digest). Drop CSV and send windows. @josh @priya please weigh in.

josh: Love the name. Proposed cadence (short): email0 (invite) -> 48h reminder -> 24h pre-webinar nudge -> 2h live reminder -> post-webinar recap (with replay + CTAs). For registrants, shorten to 24h between 0 and reminder.

priya: Segment CSV draft (paste):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
web_reg_14d,registered_at>=-14d,webinar registrants last 14d
web_attend,attended=true,attended live
news_active_30d,last_open<=30d,newsletter engagers
trial_lowtouch_14d,trial_started<=14d AND usage<5,low touch trials
```
Exclude `unsubscribed` and `no_marketing`. Also exclude any accounts flagged for privacy review.

emma: Creative tests: Postcard = minimalist hero + three bullet benefits + big CTA. Digest = longer, includes mini-bench highlights (chart) + link to benchmark doc. We'll A/B 50/50 for web_reg_14d; for web_attend push Postcard 70% (higher urgency). Preheader variants for Postcard: "Webinar tomorrow 4 seats left" vs "Quick checklist for the webinar".

katie: RSVP survey: one-question radio (primary use-case). Use answers to route to SDR drip lists. Make sure to add `utm_campaign=postcard_micro&utm_source=email`.

ops_bot: Throttles and scheduling: daily quota 1,000,000. Recommended concurrency: 220, batch 150. Ramp: `--ramp 8m`. Failover: if provider 5xx > 2.5% for 5m, switch to backup provider and route failing segment to `fallback-postcard`. Also soft pause rule: pause region if bounce_rate>3% for 15m.

josh: Send windows: APAC local 09:00, NA local 11:00, EMEA local 16:00. For live 2h nudge send at webinar local timezone -2h and -15m for final ping.

priya: I'll export segments and include a sample: total sizes 
```
web_reg_14d, 24,500
web_attend, 3,800
news_active_30d, 41,200
trial_lowtouch_14d, 2,700
```
Drop path: s3://marketing/postcard/segments_v1.csv. Include header row exactly as in snippet.

emma: Also want to test subject microcopy: short (<=45 chars) vs benefit-led (longer). We'll measure open rate and register-to-attend conversion. For trial_lowtouch push trial playbook link in email 2.

mailer-bot: File uploaded to s3://marketing/postcard/segments_v1.csv. Detected 4 segments, validating header/rows. MD5: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924.

ops_bot: Confirmed upload. Scheduling job epoch 1729992000 for the first invite. Concurrency 220, batch 150, ramp 8m. Failover file: s3://marketing/postcard/fallback.csv. Added pause rule for region EMEA if bounce_rate>3% (15m).

katie: A note on tracking: include `utm_content=postcard_v1` or `digest_v1` per variant. Also add a header `X-Campaign: postcard_micro` for downstream analytics ingestion.

josh: One more ops ask: can we set a limit to 5k/min per provider to avoid throttling flags? Ops, please confirm.

ops_bot: Affirmative. Limit set: 5,000/min per provider. We'll monitor 4xx/5xx; if 4xx spikes (complaints/unsubs) above 1% in any region over 10m, auto-pause that region and notify #deliverability.

priya: Post-send debrief: we'll look at opens, clicks, register-to-attend, watch-to-conversion, and trial activation 7-day. Schedule debrief Mon 10am PT. I'll include a small eval harness to pull token-cost metrics for attendees who convert (so Optimize can tag model cohorts).

emma: Perfect. I'll post this final plan in #marketing with the S3 link and pin. Thanks team! :shipit:
